headline: Raw satellite counts suggest fires rose +194% after 2012. That jump is the new satellite, not new fires: in VATRA's harmonized record the change is −29%. Over 2003–2025 there is no clear trend (Mann–Kendall p = 0.43). The worst year was 2007, the worst month August 2012, and the county with the most fire activity is Vlorë.
